author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: System Dynamics - Emergent Division of Labor with Strong Nudge and Preferred Projects
abstract: This refined submission for 'Emergent Division of Labor' introduces a stronger 'specialization nudge' alongside initial 'preferred projects' to foster robust specialization. Learning agents, if insufficiently specialized, will temporarily increase allocation to their most-assigned project. Each agent also begins with an initial value bias towards a specific preferred project. The `allocation_history_window` is extended to 20, and `epsilon_start` is reduced for faster convergence. This experiment, running for 600 rounds in a dynamic environment with increased individual resource shares, aims to drive and measure the emergence of clear, sustained specialized roles through cultural transmission, thereby improving collective performance and structured cooperation.
